paper.title: A public dataset of overground and treadmill walking kinematics and kinetics in healthy individuals

pinned_source.access: Public file URLs, no account required for reviewed metadata/code/model files. Large data archives not downloaded.
pinned_source.redistribution: CC BY 4.0 permits sharing/adaptation with attribution, license link and changes indicated. Preserve author/source attribution; dataset license does not grant rights to proprietary Visual3D software.

version_warning: Paper and v4 source describe42 participants. v6 describes 51; bundled MATLAB script still loops24 young + 18 older. Never reuse its cohort counts for v6 or silently mix old gait-event archive with updated data.

protocol.speeds: Source script identifies3 overground conditions slow/comfortable/fast and8 treadmill condition codes. Actual per-participant speeds require WBDSinfo.csv.
signals: source gait events in a separately listed archive
protocol.model_provenance: Original WBDSmodel.mdh and wbdsOvergroundDA.v3s are available and checksum-verified as source text; Visual3D reprocessing has not been performed.
protocol.source_event_evidence: Overground pipeline sets 20 N force-platform threshold, uses Automatic_Gait_Events and exports RON+RON and LON+LON windows separately. Exact raw timestamps/foot association still require pilot.
protocol.processed_grid_evidence: Author MATLAB plotting script constructs 101 points from 0 to 100; pipeline enables normalized export. Actual table layout and individual cycle versus ensemble semantics remain unverified.
protocol.bilateral_warning: Leg-specific normalized windows must not be joined by row number or synthetic half-cycle offset.

Verify source clocks/events/leg identity and transformations against original pipeline; convert only supported measured signals, retaining unknowns.

Run one serial bounded pilot, independent source readback, observation 150-point/endpoints checks where cycles are justified, provenance and missingness tests. No active download link until immutable converted output exists.
